title: Green 1993 outer posterior annulus vertical tensile Young's modulus at failure

quantity.name: Young's modulus at failure
quantity.definition: modulus from specimen stiffness at the failure point

source.authors: Green TP, Adams MA, Dolan P
source.sample: 22 vertical bone-AF-bone slices (5 mm thick, ~15 mm wide pairs) from 7 cadaveric lumbar spines: 9 outer anterior, 10 outer posterior, 3 inner anterior; fatigue on matched halves

protocol.summary: Vertical slices of annulus with bone ends (5 mm thick, 15 mm wide matched pairs), bony ends potted in dental stone; hydration precautions per Part I (Adams & Green 1993); 6 preconditioning cycles (2 s ramp) to ~50% estimated UTS; one specimen of each pair stretched vertically (axial) to failure at 4 mm/s; YM from stiffness at failure point; matched specimen cyclically loaded at a % of its estimated UTS until failure or 10000 cycles. In situ values estimated by correcting for fibres cut in slices (specimens retain ~44%).
how_to_simulate: Model a 5 mm thick, 15 mm wide vertical slice of outer AF with vertebral bone ends (~10 mm AF height) potted rigidly
Apply vertical (axial) tension at 4 mm/s to failure after 6 preconditioning cycles
Report failure stress (force / unloaded CSA), failure strain (displacement / height) and modulus at failure

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 from text layer, checked visually aligned (mean +- SD). doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
